messages:
Maya (CS): Heads-up: we have a Lunar Labs kickoff tomorrow 10am PT. I drafted a short, customer-facing one-page runbook for prefill/cache, batching defaults, streaming fallbacks, and initial renewal-risk signals. Posting for quick review.

Owen (CS Ops): Nice. Could we add a single curl command to verify streaming so demos don't flake?

Maya (CS): yup. curl + tiny config snippet. Also adding short list of metrics for their PM to watch.

Devon (SRE): Recommend warm pools + jittered prefill to avoid stampedes. Prefill window 5-15m based on expected ramp. Also note batch_timeout tuning: 8ms on Dedicated, 12ms on Hosted.

Maya (CS): Draft checklist below. Lina, please preview and tell us if it's customer-friendly.

Lina (Customer): looks clear. Please include which metrics to surface in our dashboard.

Maya (CS): Adding three priority metrics: 95p completion latency, tokens/session, streaming disconnect rate. Also recommend verbose logs for first 48h retained for 7 days.

Owen (CS Ops): Config snippet for them to drop into onboarding guide:
```
# Client guidance (suggested defaults)
# 1) Prefill: call /v1/prefill for top prompts with concurrency 2-4
# 2) Batching: batch_size 8-16, batch_timeout 8-12ms (dedicated/hosted)
# 3) Streaming: keepalive every 30s, fallback short-poll 500ms if repeated drops
```

Devon (SRE): Also recommend KV cache TTL 1h for initial demos, bump to 6-12h in stable prod if prompt templates are stable.

Maya (CS): One-line curl test for streaming validation:
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams -d '{"model":"xx-demo","prompt":"ping","stream":true}'
```

Maya (CS): Customer-facing checklist (one-pager):
- Preflight (24h): run prefill for top prompts, confirm 200 responses, KV-cache hit rate >60%
- Day 0: set batch_timeout conservative (12ms hosted / 8ms dedicated), enable streaming keepalive, watch 95p latency live
- Days 1-7: keep verbose logs, monitor token consumption, flag repeated disconnects or tail latency >2x baseline as renewal risk signals

Lina (Customer): Could you add a client backoff snippet for 503s? We want to show resilience strategy.

Owen (CS Ops): Add exponential backoff + jitter, circuit-breaker after 5 consecutive 503s for 60s. Auto-fallback to smaller model variant if errors persist >2m.

Maya (CS): We'll capture a quick feedback form post-demo (3 fields: perceived latency, correctness %, streaming issues). We'll use answers to trigger follow-up tuning.

Devon (SRE): Ops play: if streaming disconnect rate >1% for 10m, auto-scale and ping oncall with runbook link.

Maya (CS): @enablement-bot please attach the single-page PDF and an email template for Lunar Labs.

enablement-bot: Attached lunar-prefill-onepager-v2.pdf and lunar-kickoff-email.txt

Owen (CS Ops): LGTM. I'll join the call and help walk through the checklist. Lina, we'll keep it light and iterate after first 24h. :white_check_mark:
